يحتفلوا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَفِلُوا (yaḥtafilū) /jaħ.ta.fi.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# يُحْتَفَلُوا (yuḥtafalū) /juħ.ta.fa.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
